summary.headline: Death and Recovery Judgments
summary.text: Astrological rules for judging death or recovery in an interrogation concerning a sick person, based on conjunctions involving the lord of the ascendant, malefic planets, the lord of the house of death, the Moon, reception, impediment, and timing by degrees or bodily conjunction.
